iPhone 17 Pro Original Display

This is a genuine Apple Super Retina XDR OLED display assembly for the iPhone 17 Pro, pulled from an original device — not an aftermarket or copy screen. The assembly includes the complete factory display stack: the LTPO OLED panel, the integrated touch layer, and the Ceramic Shield 2 front glass with Apple's anti-reflective coating. Every unit is function-tested before sale and comes with an 18-month warranty against display defects.

Display Technology and Specifications: iPhone 17 Pro

The iPhone 17 Pro uses one of the most advanced smartphone panels Apple has shipped, and because this unit is pulled from a genuine device, every specification below is the factory specification — nothing is downgraded or approximated.

Panel: 6.3-inch Super Retina XDR OLED with LTPO technology and a resolution of 2622×1206 pixels at 460 pixels per inch. Text renders sharp at any viewing distance, and the OLED panel delivers a 2,000,000:1 contrast ratio with true blacks, since individual pixels switch off completely.

ProMotion adaptive refresh: The LTPO panel dynamically scales its refresh rate from 1Hz up to 120Hz. Scrolling, gaming, and animations run at up to 120Hz for full smoothness, while the panel drops to 1Hz for static content — which is also what enables the Always-On display without significant battery drain. Aftermarket panels are typically fixed at 60Hz and cannot support Always-On; this one behaves exactly like the factory screen because it is one.

Brightness: 1,000 nits typical maximum, 1,600 nits peak for HDR content, and 3,000 nits peak outdoor brightness — the highest outdoor brightness Apple has shipped on an iPhone. Combined with the factory anti-reflective coating, the display stays fully readable in direct Dhaka sunlight, where lower-grade panels wash out.

Color and calibration: Full P3 wide color gamut with Apple's factory color calibration, True Tone ambient color adjustment, and HDR support including Dolby Vision. Colors and skin tones display exactly as Apple tuned them.

Front glass: Ceramic Shield 2 with approximately 3× the scratch resistance of the original Ceramic Shield, plus the anti-reflective, fingerprint-resistant coating. Copy screens use standard glass that scratches and glares noticeably more.

Integrated components: The assembly retains the factory touch digitizer with full 120Hz touch sampling responsiveness, Haptic Touch support, the ambient light sensing window, and the Dynamic Island cutout with correct tolerances for the TrueDepth system.

How It Compares With OEM and Copy Panels

The technical gap between display grades is measurable, not cosmetic. OEM/aftermarket "original quality" panels are built in third-party factories on lower-grade OLED substrates: they typically run at a fixed 60Hz instead of adaptive 1–120Hz, lose True Tone and Always-On support, reach noticeably lower peak brightness, and draw more power because they lack LTPO's variable refresh. Copy panels (Incell/TFT) drop further — LCD or budget OLED technology with no ProMotion, no True Tone, washed-out color reproduction, weaker touch sampling, and lifespans that often fall under a year. The pulled original panel is the only grade that preserves the complete iPhone 17 Pro display specification: LTPO adaptive refresh, 3,000-nit outdoor brightness, factory color calibration, and Ceramic Shield 2 protection.
